items.prompt:
Improving the ideas and organization of a draft is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) printing

Fixing spelling and punctuation is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Feedback from classmates is called:
A) peer feedback
B) a conclusion
C) a citation

A peer says your paragraphs are in a confusing order. Reordering them is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) proofreading

You find a misspelled word and a missing comma. Fixing these is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Adding more evidence to strengthen your argument is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) formatting

Which change is REVISING, not editing?
A) cutting an off-topic paragraph and rewriting the intro
B) fixing a typo
C) adding a missing period
items.answer: A) cutting an off-topic paragraph and rewriting the intro

solution.answer: A) cutting an off-topic paragraph and rewriting the intro

items.prompt:
The BEST reason to seek peer feedback before a final draft is to:
A) find weaknesses a fresh reader notices so you can strengthen the writing
B) copy a classmate's work
C) avoid revising
items.answer: A) find weaknesses a fresh reader notices so you can strengthen the writing

steps: Feedback improves the draft. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) find weaknesses a fresh reader notices so you can strengthen the writing
